marta: FYI Acme POC failing on our private endpoint in us-east-1. Clients hit TLS handshake failures; SDK times out after ~7s. Can eng/network look?

ben: Any gateway logs or client error strings?

marta: Client: `tls: handshake failure` then `context deadline exceeded`. Gateway: repeated OCSP fetch attempts + `dial tcp 10.52.9.4:80: i/o timeout`.

owen: Sounds like customer DNS returns RFC1918 for public OCSP host or they block NAT egress. Are they using an interface endpoint or NAT?

marta: They said "no NAT" and only private endpoints + strict egress ACLs.

owen: Checklist for customer (run from connector host): 1) `dig +short ocsp.trustca.com @<resolver>` 2) `getent hosts ocsp.trustca.com` 3) `openssl s_client -connect ocsp.trustca.com:80 -status -servername ocsp.trustca.com` 4) `tcpdump -s0 -w /tmp/ocsp.pcap tcp and host ocsp.trustca.com`. Share outputs.

lia: Options for POC: a) customer allows egress to CA OCSP IPs (least infra change), b) customer runs an internal OCSP mirror reachable from our connector, c) we offer a short-term Private trial inside their VPC or d) temporary client skip-OCSP flag (security approval required).

marta: Procurement asked if managed egress or Private deployment impacts price. @procurement-bot what are ballpark uplifts for POC?

procurement-bot: Private POC deployment: 14-day free trial. Extended 30-day trial + managed egress estimated uplift ~22% over base Dedicated list; PS for proxy setup billed separately. Exact quote via account exec.

netsec-bot: Security ticket SEC-POC-2065 created: "POC Acme private endpoint NAT/DNS egress" assigned to netops.

owen: Also check whether their resolver returns CNAMEs to internal hostnames or rewrites SNI. If `openssl s_client -servername` passes but runtime fails, capture pcap.

marta: I'll send the checklist and request a small architectural diagram showing resolver behavior and egress rules. Will update when we get outputs. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
